description: This script initializes and manages an SQLite database for a to-do list application. It creates necessary tables (including todos), sets up a trigger to keep the 'updated_at' timestamp in sync on updates, reads configuration from external files, and writes connection information and environment variables for downstream tools.

methods.name: Optional[str] _parse_db_path_from_file(contents: str)
methods.description: Extracts the database file path from the contents of the connection info file.

methods.name: Optional[str] _read_db_path_from_connection_file(conn_file: str)
methods.description: Reads 'db_connection.txt' and returns the database path if present.

methods.name: Tuple[str,bool] get_database_path()
methods.description: Returns the database path and whether it was discovered from external config.

methods.name: None _ensure_dir(path: str)
methods.description: Ensures the directory for the database file exists.

methods.name: None _exec_one(cursor: sqlite3.Cursor, sql: str, params: Tuple = ())
methods.description: Executes a single SQL statement with optional parameters.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that sets up the database, creates tables and triggers, and writes configuration files.

ctags.name: _exec_one
ctags.pattern: /^def _exec_one(cursor: sqlite3.Cursor, sql: str, params: Tuple = ()) -> None:$/
